name: Aneimo Chikan
source:
The protagonist is groping on a routine basis.
One day, he recognizes his sister as a woman and gropes her as well.

He can no longer hold back the desire for his sisters and begins to take action..

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045752.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角在日常的摸索中。
有一天，他认出了他的妹妹是一个女人，并对她进行了抚摸。

他再也无法抑制对妹妹的渴望，开始采取行动。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045752.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
